nvidia-nim.name: NVIDIA NIM Developer Catalog

groq-cloud.name: Groq Cloud LPU

cloudflare-workers-ai.name: Cloudflare Workers AI (Clef & Clairic)

pollinations.name: Pollinations AI (Keyless Fallback)
pollinations.quota: Keyless Zero-Auth Fair-Use IP Quota (Text, FLUX Image, Audio)

firecrawl.name: Firecrawl (Keyless Skill & API)
firecrawl.quota: Keyless onboarding skill + 500 credits on signup

jina-reader.quota: Keyless prefix + 10M free tokens with API key

exa-search.name: Exa 3.0 Neural Search
exa-search.quota: No Card: $10/mo recurring credits + $10 bonus (10 QPS search)

openalex.name: OpenAlex Academic Graph
proof: 250M+ scholarly works, citation graphs, and open-access PDFs
gotchas: Pass ?mailto=you@domain.com in URLs to enter the fast polite pool.

qwen3.8-27b.name: Qwen3.8-27B (Dense Vision+Text Backbone)
proof: Top 16GB VRAM dense coding & strict-instruction backbone (73.0 Terminal-Bench, 94.9 SWE-Pro Unsloth)
Single frozen backbone hosting both HF Harness RL Adapters and Securelayer7 26 MB uncensored LoRA
gotchas: Use IQ4_XS + Q8 KV cache on 16GB VRAM so weights never spill across PCIe.

qwen3-coder-next.name: Qwen3-Coder-Next (80B-A3B Sparse MoE)
proof: 512-expert sparse MoE activating 3B params/token; battle-tested daily driver in llama.cpp & ik_llama.cpp
qwen3-coder-next.launch_recipe: GGML_CUDA_GRAPH_OPT=1 llama-server -m Qwen3-Coder-Next-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf -ngl 99 -fa on -c 120000 --load-mode none --n-cpu-moe 29 -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0 --temp 0
gotchas: Never lower -ngl on MoEs; keep Attention/KV on GPU and sweep --n-cpu-moe.

gemma-4.name: Gemma 4 Family (26B-A4B Vision & 12B Tri-Modal)
proof: 26B-A4B runs ~140 tok/s 100% resident in 16GB VRAM; 12B adds native local audio input
gotchas: Gemma 4 Audio Trap: only E2B/E4B/12B process audio; 26B-A4B is Text + Vision only.

hermes-4.name: NousResearch Hermes 4 (14B / 4.3-36B Neutral)
proof: Tops RefusalBench via neutral alignment: uncensored by default while obeying operator system-prompt policies
gotchas: Author explicit operator rules in the system prompt if deploying beyond solo use.

inkling-2-mini.name: Inkling 2 Mini (26.4B Looped Transformer MoE)
proof: Middle 12 of 24 layers loop 3x (3.4B base / 5.4B eff. active, 1M ctx); 79.2% SWE-bench Verified, 48.2% DeepSWE v1.1
Mainline llama.cpp (#32218, Nov 23) now supports looped layers & DSpark natively alongside Unsloth
gotchas: Trails Qwen3.8-27B on strict chat (50% MultiChallenge); cap turns/tokens to avoid repetitive debug loops and sandbox file edits.

laya-05.name: Laya 0.5 (Multimodal System-1 Decision Model)
proof: Evaluates 64 typed decisions per pass in <100-500ms; v0.5 reads text, images, audio & video up to 73,728 tokens
Installs cleanly via pip install -U laya; serves via Unsloth Decision API (localhost:8888)
gotchas: Threshold on probabilities (not confidence); vegaml-learn continuous learning add-on is non-commercial.

qwen-image-2.1.name: Qwen-Image-2.1 (7B DiT Native RGBA)
proof: #1 VDEBench; native RGBA layer output and 2048px typography inside 16GB VRAM
gotchas: Non-commercial Qwen Research license; use FLUX.2 Klein (Apache-2.0) for commercial graphics.

wan-2.2.name: Wan 2.2 (5B & A14B Open Video)

hardware.footprint: 6-15 GB VRAM via WanGP MMGP v4

proof: Top permissive Apache-2.0 local video checkpoint accelerated by WanGP v20.12
gotchas: Wan 3.0 and Wan 2.6 remain closed APIs with no published weights.

pi.name: Pi Coding Agent (+ @earendil-works/pi-durable)
proof: Minimal hackable TUI/RPC/SDK loop with /tree DAG branching, MCP + Codemode JS sandbox, and first-party pi-durable SQLite checkpoints
Highest-scoring HF Harness Adapter target (64.7% SWE-Pro hard-51) and Inkling 2 Mini reference harness
gotchas: Intentionally omits built-in per-tool approval prompts; pair with safeagents or OS sandboxes.

deepseek-harness.name: DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
proof: Cordis everything-is-a-plugin architecture letting you swap the agent loop itself, Creator Mode, & built-in read-only sandbox
First-party plugins orchestrate Claude Code & Codex as sub-agents; supports local OpenAI-compat servers
gotchas: Fast-moving developer preview (0.2.3-alpha.2); pin plugin versions against breaking API changes.

hermes-agent.name: Hermes Agent (v0.23.4)
proof: #1 globally on OpenRouter token volume; persistent memory, autonomous skill creation, Telegram/cron/ACP, 40+ tools
Official HF Harness Adapter target (Qwen3.8-27B-hermes-adapted)
gotchas: Does not auto-compact aggressively like Pi by default; cap thinking/context tokens on giant repos.

opencode.name: OpenCode CLI
proof: Clean terminal coding agent with official HF Qwen3.8-27B-opencode-adapted LoRA
gotchas: Watch context length on multi-hour repos; does not auto-compact as aggressively as Pi.

safeagents.name: Hugging Face safeagents Runtime Proxy
proof: Transparent OpenAI/Anthropic proxy with atif-scan (10-20ms on Apple Silicon) & optional Decision Model judge
Audited 1.3M RL tool calls and blocked 647 suspicious calls during HF harness-adapter training
gotchas: Configure a domain plugin (e.g. hf://harness-hub/qwen-safeagents-plugin) rather than running empty defaults.

qwen38-super-adapter.name: Qwen3.8-27B Rank-96 Super-Adapter (HF Harness Hub)
proof: Zero-retraining orthogonal rank-96 merge (PEFT cat, wt 0.5) of pi, Hermes, & OpenCode RL LoRAs (cosine sim 0.01-0.02)
GGUF LoRA adds only +912 MiB (+304 MiB for single-harness specialist) on top of frozen Qwen3.8-27B

eval_tables.title: HF Harness Adapters Summary: Base vs. Specialist vs. Rank-96 Super-Adapter (Qwen3.8-27B)

qwen38-super-adapter.launch_recipe: llama-server -m Qwen3.8-27B-IQ4_XS.gguf --lora Qwen3.8-27B-super-adapter-F16.gguf -ngl 99 -fa on -c 65536 -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0
gotchas: Decision rule: single harness + thinking off -> use specialist LoRA; thinking on or multi-harness -> use super-adapter.
Trained on BF16; verify GGUF quant fidelity and expect mild pre-tool reasoning leakage (arXiv:2610.14270).

qwen38-abliterated-lora.name: Qwen3.8-27B 26MB Uncensored LoRA (Rank-3)
proof: Tiny 26 MB rank-3 LoRA (built on Apple Silicon) hot-swapping over the exact same frozen Qwen3.8-27B backbone
gotchas: Abliterated adapters cannot refuse harmful tool actions; always isolate behind safeagents + Laya 0.5.

hf-in-harness-rl.name: HF In-Harness RL Recipe (OpenEnv + Harbor + TRL AsyncGRPO)
proof: Trains LoRAs directly inside unmodified shipping harnesses via token/logprob capture proxy (echoing Agent Lightning v1.0)
openenv validate passed 858/1,127 tasks; base-model difficulty filtering drove the largest GRPO reward lift

eval_tables.title: TB2.1 Lift Experiment (Qwen3.8-27B · LoRA AsyncGRPO · 32 tasks/arm · 8xH200 · Base TB2.1 pass@1: 35.9%)

gotchas: Use all-linear LoRA, LR 2e-5 (1e-4 collapses rollouts), tool bonus 0.1, & never train GRPO on all-pass/all-fail tasks.

llama-cpp.name: llama.cpp (Mainline GGUF + Looped Layers)
proof: Universal CUDA/Metal/Vulkan/ROCm engine with --n-cpu-moe offload, --lora hot-loading, --load-mode, & PR #32218 Inkling looped support
gotchas: --no-mmap is deprecated (use --load-mode none); add -cuda graphs=0 if partial MoE offload outputs gibberish.

unsloth-runtime.name: Unsloth Runtime & Studio
proof: 3x faster VRAM-exceeding MoE GGUFs, Anthropic-compatible local API for Claude Code, Decision API, & Bwrap/Seatbelt/MXC sandboxes

local-media-studio.title: Local Media Studio (Video, Image, Motion & Voice)
local-media-studio.verdict: Anchor local 16GB video and RGBA image pipelines in WanGP v20.12 + Wan 2.2 / Qwen-Image-2.1, paired with Hyperframes for code-driven MP4s.
workflow: Use Hyperframes for crisp programmatic product demos, UI animations, and launch graphics.
Generate consistent AI video clips inside 5.9-15 GB VRAM via WanGP v20.12 (Extreme Chunker + MMGP v4).
Assemble final edits in DaVinci Resolve via MCP and synthesize fast English voiceovers via Phonon 31M.
guardrails: Qwen-Image-2.1 is non-commercial (Qwen Research); swap to FLUX.2 Klein (Apache-2.0) for commercial graphics.

research-and-grounding.title: Deep Research & Cited Literature Synthesis
research-and-grounding.verdict: Combine GPT Researcher with card-free Exa 3.0, Firecrawl, Jina, and keyless OpenAlex (100K/day) for high-precision cited synthesis.
workflow: Pull open-access papers and citation graphs via OpenAlex (?mailto=...) and semantic discovery via Exa 3.0.
Run GPT Researcher across web sources and local PDF/CSV folders for cited draft reports.
Verify primary DOIs, dates, and exact numbers before treating any report as publication-ready.
guardrails: Never cite autonomous research summaries without verifying primary source URLs.
